verdict.rationale: Dover documents a first-party Bulk actions feature for candidate management that applies the same change to many people at once instead of opening each profile, which meets the story as written. The evidence is a single short doc line, though, and does not say which operations are supported or whether bulk changes can run through the API or MCP server. missing for 10: list of supported bulk operations, documented bulk/batch endpoints for programmatic or AI-driven use, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Bulk actions let you apply the same change to many people at once, instead of opening each profile.
